comparison.objective: Separate exactly six casino chips from a stack and place them as a payout beside the bet.
comparison.physical_skill: Position a pinch within one 3.3 mm chip layer, lift an exact substack, and restack it neatly.
comparison.success_condition: Exactly six chips in a separate stack; capping or disturbing the bet, toppling a chip, or losing one off-table permanently fails. No full spec version is present.
comparison.reason: This tests ultra-fine layer selection and stack transfer, not tool-mediated adjustment, locking, or dynamic commissioning.
